preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 400.
n must be a power of 2 between 4 and 2^16.
k must be between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(a & b == k for a in range(n) for b in range(a + 1, n)) else True

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == n // 2 + 1 if stdout != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If valid pairs exist, output n/2 pairs plus one line for the result.

postconditions.expression: all(int(pair[0]) & int(pair[1]) == k for pair in stdout.splitlines()[:-1])
postconditions.description: Each pair must have a bitwise AND sum equal to k.
